objective: Find an existing or low-risk way to verify future GPU up/down candidates token-by-token against the accepted SOTA path before any more performance experiments.

accepted_sota_reference.strict_limits: cold drop_caches, 16GB cgroup including page cache, MemorySwapMax=0, TTFT <= 33617.688744 ms, France manual correctness pass

llama_debug_save_logits.capability: Can save logits for the final prompt position with --save-logits.
llama_debug_save_logits.limitation: It only calls llama_get_logits_ith(ctx, tokens.size() - 1), so it does not verify every generated step or a full forced sequence.

llama_perplexity_save_all_logits_and_kl.capability: Can evaluate fixed text windows, save compressed log-probability data, and report aggregate KL / Same top p statistics against a base logits file.
llama_perplexity_save_all_logits_and_kl.limitation: Default mode requires tokens.size() >= 2*n_ctx and only evaluates the last half of each context window. KL mode reports aggregate same-top percentage, not a per-position mismatch list with token ids and margins.

server_n_probs.capability: Can return top_logprobs / token ids during online generation when n_probs > 0.
server_n_probs.limitation: This is an online single-path generation API. It records probabilities but does not compare an accepted path and a candidate path under identical forced tokens.

common_sampler_logits_access.capability: The sampler layer can access full logits via llama_get_logits_ith when sampled logits/probs are not supplied.
common_sampler_logits_access.limitation: There is no current CLI flag that emits a complete token-by-token top1/top2/margin report for a fixed accepted output sequence.

llama_results.capability: Most useful existing base. It tokenizes a fixed prompt, sets batch logits=true for every token, stores all logits in a GGUF result file, and --check compares a new run against a previous result.
llama_results.limitation: The existing --check gate is NMSE only. It does not report per-token top1 equality, top2 margin, first mismatch, or whether the accepted next token remains top1. It also evaluates the whole fixed text as prompt/prefill, not the exact one-token generation loop.

verdict.reason: No existing command fully proves that a candidate GPU up/down path emits the same greedy token sequence as the accepted SOTA path. Existing tools provide partial logits/probability evidence but not a complete forced-sequence top1/top2/margin report.
verdict.why: It already evaluates a fixed token sequence and materializes all logits for every position. A small default-off extension can compare top1/top2/margin per position without touching llama-cli runtime behavior.

next_plan.name: llama-results top1 verifier extension
next_plan.purpose: Create a diagnostic correctness mechanism before any future GPU up/down performance candidate.
next_plan.expected_token_rate_gain: 0 tok/s directly; this only enables safe validation of future high-risk candidates.
implementation_scope: default-off flag or output mode only
required_output: first top1 mismatch position if any
accepted token id and candidate token id
next_plan.memory_accounting_before_run: For a diagnostic France sequence, estimate logits bytes as n_tokens * n_vocab * 4. Abort or lower n_ctx if the resulting anonymous/output buffer would materially threaten the 16GB cgroup. For n_tokens <= 256 and n_vocab <= 200000, logits storage is <= 204800000 bytes per result matrix before overhead.
next_plan.ttft_impact: Not applicable to SOTA promotion. Any diagnostic run still records elapsed time and memory but cannot be accepted as token-rate improvement.
rollback_criteria: tool cannot compare top1/margins from existing result files
diagnostic memory exceeds the 16GB cgroup when tested
